title: GET /api/mxl/v1/sources
description: The switchable sources, each with a STABLE opaque id (addressable by /v1/cut and /v1/preview), a human label, a kind, display order, and health. Replaces the fragile slot-index + role-name model; derived per box from discovered flows (review R2), so a skin written once works on any box.

id.description: Opaque stable id, derived deterministically from the flow UUID (stable for the flow's life, identical in /state and /sources). A skin stores it and never parses it.

label.description: Human label from the facility manifest.

kind.description: What the source is, for grouping/iconography in a skin.

order.description: Display order only (the old layout slot index). NEVER an address — cut by id.

state.description: ok=fresh frames; no_signal=wired but nothing arriving; stale=frames aging; wedged=reader stuck (the cold-reader wedge, R1); unknown=can't tell yet. Replaces the overloaded 'live' (which only meant 'wired').

last_frame_age_ms.description: Age of the most recent frame, if known (from mxl_thumbs.py health). null when not measurable in v1.0.
